resources.string: Mirrors Google Maps walking and cycling directions to your Pebble, with a small map of where you are and where the next turn is. Start directions in Google Maps and the watchapp opens by itself.
Notification access: needed to read the Google Maps directions
Location: needed to draw the map around you
Background location: allowed all the time
Background location: needed because directions start while Google Maps is in front, not this app

L left, R right, S straight, U U-turn, O roundabout, D destination, M merge, X exit. A short E before the letter means slight, a long T means sharp. Played on each new instruction and again 40 m before the turn.
Keep the backlight on in the dark

After dark, on any trip, the backlight comes on as soon as you raise and turn your wrist to read the watch, and goes off again when you lower it. Darkness is worked out from your position and the time, so the light stays off in daylight. Uses more battery.
